title: Local Administrator Password Solution Attribute Read
detection_hypothesis: If managed local administrator credentials are harvested, the directory access audit will record reads of the password attribute on computer objects.

field_semantics.EventID: Numeric identifier of the Windows event record.
field_semantics.Properties: Directory attributes or property sets touched by the access request.

collection_prerequisites: The relevant advanced audit policy subcategory is enabled for success events.
Domain controller Security logs are forwarded for directory-scoped events.
expected_collection_gaps: Events raised on a domain controller that is not forwarding logs are invisible.
Security log wrapping on busy controllers can drop events before forwarding.
normalization_assumptions: EventID is an integer and Channel is the literal string Security.
Account names are provided without the domain prefix in TargetUserName.
ingestion_differences: Some pipelines rename EventID to event.code or similar.
Directory attribute events may arrive with XML-encoded values.
retention_considerations: Security log volume varies widely; 180 to 365 days is common for identity events.
expected_volume: Moderate in environments with active help desk usage.
false_positive_strategy: Reads by help desk staff are expected. The reviewable pattern is a single principal reading many computer objects in a short period, so correlate on read volume per subject.
tuning_guidance: Enrich with the subject role and the number of distinct computer objects read. Avoid excluding the help desk group, since bulk reads by that group are exactly the case worth reviewing.
test_strategy: Positive cases read the legacy and current password attributes. Negative cases read an unrelated attribute, write the attribute, and use a different event identifier.
unmapped_defensive_objects_reason: No Detection Strategy, Analytic, or Data Component identifier for this technique was present in the pinned ATT&CK extraction used by this lab. Defensive arrays are left empty rather than populated with unverified identifiers. Unmapped techniques: T1555.
author: Salvatore Mazzaglia
